mapper.select:
select count(distinct cientity.id) as ciEntityCount, ci.id as id, ci.name as name, ci.label as label, ci.icon as icon from cmdb_ci ci join cmdb_cientity cientity on ci.id = cientity.ci_id join fulltextindex_target_cmdb b on cientity.id = b.target_id and b.target_type = 'cientity' join fulltextindex_field_cmdb c on b.target_id = c.target_id join fulltextindex_word d on c.word_id = d.id where
d.word like concat(#{item},'%')
group by ci.id
